faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the International Centre for Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology (ICGEB) based in New Delhi for filling up temporary research positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post announced in the notification?
faq.answer: The positions announced are Scientific Assistant / Field worker under the research field for eligible candidates seeking temporary employment opportunities.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment drive?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Scientific Assistant / Field worker position as per the official recruitment notification details released.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduation in any discipline from a recognized university or institution to be eligible to apply for this job opening.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly salary of 18000 plus 27% HRA as per the guidelines specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to apply for ICGEB recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is 30 September 2026. Candidates must ensure timely submission before the deadline.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly via Email. Interested candidates are required to send their detailed CV to the designated email address provided.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Scientific Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises short-listing of candidates based on their CV followed by an interview round conducted by the authorities.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for applying to the Scientific Assistant / Field worker position.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the candidates send their application CV?
faq.answer: Candidates should email their CV to [email protected] with the subject line specified as Application for TA position in PMI group.
